X.1 Start of message: The message begins with an XML declaration line.
X.14 Using XHTML: An XHTML fragment may not use event attributes (onfocus/onblur are still declared on <a> in the subset).
X.14 Using XHTML: XHTML markup must not be mixed with Unicode interlinear annotation delimiters (U+FFF9-U+FFFB) in one element.
P.5.5b Collection sequence type name: CollectionSequenceTypeName present iff CollectionSequenceType is proprietary (List 197 code 01).
Title element composite (collection): A TitleElement inside <Collection> must not use TitleElementLevel 01 (product level).
P.9.4 Edition statement: An EditionStatement must be accompanied by at least one EditionType or an EditionNumber.
P.13.4a Audience heading text: Repeated AudienceHeadingText must each carry a language attribute.
P.14.5a Text source description: Repeated TextSourceDescription must each carry a language attribute.
P.15.8 Resource link: Where multiple languages are used in CitedContent/ResourceLink, all repeats carry the language attribute.
Event occurrence date composite (P.27): Each EventOccurrence carries an OccurrenceDate with OccurrenceDateRole 01 (date the occurrence begins).
Funding composite (P.19): Funding is used only when PublishingRole is a funder role (List 45 codes 14, 15, 16).
P.19.13 City or town of publication: Repeated CityOfPublication must each carry a language attribute.
P.28.23 / P.28.46 Resource file feature description: Repeated ResourceFileFeatureDescription must each carry a language attribute.
P.28.24 / P.28.47 Resource file description: Repeated ResourceFileDescription must each carry a language attribute.
P.28.25 / P.28.48 Resource file content description: Repeated ResourceFileContentDescription must each carry a language attribute.
P.28.36 Specification feature description: Repeated SpecificationFeatureDescription must each carry a language attribute.
P.28.37 Specification description: Repeated SpecificationDescription must each carry a language attribute.
P.28.61 Insertion point value: InsertPointValue conforms to the format of InsertPointType (List 255: ALP/APP integer page number; ATC HHHMMSS[cc]).
P.28.92 Product form description (supplement): Repeated ProductFormDescription in SupplementManifest must each carry a language attribute.
P.26.15 Returns code type name: ReturnsCodeTypeName present iff ReturnsCodeType is proprietary (List 53 code 00).
New supplier composite (P.26): NewSupplier is used only when ProductAvailability is List 65 code 43.
Stock quantity composite (P.26): If Stock is repeated, each instance carries a LocationIdentifier or LocationName.
P.26.34 Stock quantity code type name: StockQuantityCodeTypeName present iff StockQuantityCodeType is proprietary (List 70 code 01).
On order detail composite (P.26): Stock/OnOrder >= sum(Stock/OnOrderDetail/OnOrder) when both are present.
Price identifier composite (P.26): A PriceIdentifier (type, name, value) is unique across all Price composites of one Product.
P.26.64 Price code type name: PriceCodeTypeName present iff PriceCodeType is proprietary (List 179 code 01).
P.27.9 Event contributor role: ContributorRole values are unique within one ContributorReference (3.0 ordinary lacks the xs:unique that 3.1 ordinary and 3.0 strict carry).
X.4 Empty XML elements: SubjectDescription (new in 3.1.3) must not be empty (only XHTML-enabled element missing from the _20180517_b_* family).
X.4 Empty XML elements: ProductSupply cannot be entirely empty (block update may carry only MarketReference).
Using ONIX schemas for validation: xsi:schemaLocation / xsi:noNamespaceSchemaLocation must be removed before exchange (3.1.3 "must"; 3.0.8 "should").
X.14 Using XHTML: XHTML markup in SubjectDescription requires textformat="05" (missing from the _20171208_g_* family).
X.15 Multilingual text / P.14.6a Text source link: Repeated TextSourceLink must each carry a unique language attribute.
X.18 Using JSON-LD: A JSON-LD Text (TextType 24) begins with the @context and @type members.
P.5 Collection (introduction): At most one collection-level (02) TitleElement in the Group P.6 TitleDetail.
Collection composite: A Collection without TitleDetail must be a publisher collection (CollectionType 10) whose title is carried at collection level in Group P.6.
P.5.2a Collection title element level: CollectionElementLevel matches a TitleElementLevel in the same Collection (or in Group P.6 when the Collection has no TitleDetail).
P.5.2a Collection title element level (List 149 note): CollectionElementLevel must not use List 149 codes 01 or 04.
P.21.9a Publisher name, inverted: PublisherNameInverted in SalesRights is used only when SalesRightsType indicates not-for-sale.
Issue-74 List 158 code 53 note: ResourceContentType 53 ("Deprecated, except for use in ONIX 3.0") must not be used in a 3.1 message.
3.1.3 'Using ONIX schemas for validation': any DOCTYPE declaration 'must be removed prior to making the ONIX message available to supply chain partners'
